name: MultiNeRF
definition: A 3D watermarking method that embeds multiple uniquely keyed watermarks within images rendered by a single Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) model (specifically TensoRF) at training time, maintaining high visual quality and allowing extraction without model retraining.
summary: MultiNeRF is a 3D watermarking method that embeds multiple uniquely keyed watermarks within a single Neural Radiance Field model by isolating watermark features in a dedicated grid, enabling scalable, robust digital watermarking without model retraining.
